# MsQuic 2.5.12 Windows headers

The two ABI headers are unchanged from Microsoft MsQuic tag `v2.5.12`.
Their MIT license is included in this directory and copied into release
notices. RelaxDesk uses the MsQuic DLL bundled by the .NET runtime.

https://github.com/microsoft/msquic/tree/v2.5.12/src/inc
